solar_environment.model_note: Earth-centered display frame with true-distance Sun vector, Earth heliocentric orbit state, Moon geocentric orbit state, and Sun/Moon third-body perturbation gravity. Control decisions are external.

environment_model.description: Earth/Sun/Moon environment vectors for external attitude, roll, antenna, solar panel optimization, and third-body gravity awareness.

radiation_environment.description: Earth-only radiation belts and solar-storm telemetry layer. Exports space-weather risk fields for external decision systems; no routing inside the sim.

decision_request.note: Simulation only exports radiation/RF/collision/solar/thermal/power telemetry. External system should decide routing, satellite selection, roll optimization, or avoidance actions.
recommended_external_considerations: avoid selecting satellites with high or critical radiation risk
down-rank assets with degraded electronics health or radiation fault state
use sunlight, solar panel, voltage, thermal, RF, and radiation fields together for sensor fusion
use passive_rf_detections plus radiation alerts before issuing thruster commands

radiation_effects.description: Earth-only radiation belts and solar-storm telemetry layer. Exports space-weather risk fields for external decision systems; no routing inside the sim.

decision_request.note: Simulation only exports radiation/RF/collision/solar/thermal/power telemetry. External system should decide routing, satellite selection, roll optimization, or avoidance actions.
recommended_external_considerations: avoid selecting satellites with high or critical radiation risk

passive_rf.description: Passive RF detections from Earth satellites using a Maxwell-derived far-field electromagnetic wave approximation.

requests.reason: sensor fusion indicates power/thermal/radiation/RF/solar condition requiring external evaluation

global_considerations: Use sun vectors, panel normals, voltages, battery, camera/target geometry, thermal sensors, and radiation fields to optimize roll/panel pointing externally.
Use RF detections and collision-risk scores before issuing thruster maneuvers.
During solar storms, account for eclipse shielding, radiation fault state, communication risk, and thermal load.
